52.Install the three O-rings.
53.Select a thrust race number 8 whose thickness corresponds 
to the measured values taken in step 50 from the table 
below. Install it on thrust bearing number 7.
54.Apply a 2 mm (0.08 inch) diameter bead of sealant 
(MITSUBISHI Genuine Part number MD974421 or 
equivalent) to the illustrated position of the rear cover.
NOTE: Be sure to install the case quickly while the sealant is 
wet (within 15 minutes).
55.Install the rear cover, and tighten its mounting bolts to the 
specified torque.
Tightening torque: 23 ± 3 N⋅m (17 ± 2 ft-lb)
NOTE: After installation, keep the sealed area away from 
the oil for approximately one hour.
56.Install the underdrive clutch hub to the underdrive sun gear.
